checks.description: SKILL.md frontmatter has exactly name and description, name equals media-plan, description carries trigger phrases.
checks.rule: Frontmatter keys are name and description only; name equals 'media-plan' and the description includes trigger phrases.

checks.description: The plan covers the channel set Meta, Google, TikTok, and YouTube, selecting by fit and recording exclusions with reasons.
checks.rule: Body names Meta, Google, TikTok, and YouTube, selects channels by fit to the objective and audience, and records an excluded channel with its reason.

checks.description: The budget split is a split of the brief total; per-channel amounts sum to that total and are never invented.
checks.rule: Body allocates budget as a split of the brief total, shows per-channel amount and share, and states the shares sum to the brief total with nothing invented.

checks.description: If the total budget or campaign window is absent, the skill stops and asks rather than inventing a value.
checks.rule: Body instructs stop-and-ask when the total budget or the campaign window is missing; never invent a budget total, per-channel amount, or date.

checks.description: The plan states the awareness, consideration, and conversion budget shares, sourced from or confirmed against the brief objective, with the field split offered as a reasoning anchor only.
checks.rule: Body asks the strategist to state the awareness, consideration, and conversion share explicitly, sourced from or confirmed against the brief objective, offers the roughly 20/30/50 split as a reasoning anchor only and never an assumed value, and keeps the shares summing to the brief total.

checks.description: The plan names whether budget sits at campaign level (CBO) or ad-set level (ABO) and ties it to the test-then-scale path.
checks.rule: Body names the budget-level decision as CBO (campaign budget optimization) versus ABO (ad-set budget optimization), records the chosen level and reason, and ties ABO to testing and CBO to scaling a proven winner.

checks.description: Flighting lays out the schedule and pacing across the campaign window.
checks.rule: Body lays out flighting with schedule, pacing, and phases across the campaign window, including a learning phase allowance.

checks.description: Every channel and split ties to the success_metric and the brief target.
checks.rule: Body ties every channel and budget split to the strategy-artifact success_metric and the brief target.

checks.description: The plan never spends or launches; the build is handed to paid-build-engineer and staged paused, spend is gated.
checks.rule: Body states the plan never spends and never launches, the build is staged paused by paid-build-engineer, and spend is authorized only at the human gate.

checks.description: No invented budget, target, offer, price, Skill Path title, or instructor name.
checks.rule: Body forbids inventing budgets, targets, offers, prices, Skill Path titles, and instructor names, and bars accreditation and roadmap leaks.

checks.description: No em dashes, no tatweel, Western numerals only across the file.
checks.rule: File contains no U+2014 em dash, no U+0640 tatweel, and no Eastern Arabic numerals (U+0660 to U+0669).
